# Get PDF page count

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `pdf.meta.page_count.task` |
| Source | `07_tasks/pdf.meta.page_count.task.yaml` |
| Tags | task |

Return the page count of a PDF file using the pdfinfo command-line tool.
Returns null if pdfinfo is unavailable or fails.
Wraps lib.pdf.meta.page_count.

### Run Operations

#### Python

_No operation description provided._

```python
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from lib.pdf.meta import page_count

count = page_count(Path("{{ path }}"))
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump({"page_count": count, "path": "{{ path }}"}, f)

```
